declaredBefore: the first experimental run of S11B

T1_1.rule: presence of the target address in the RAW DIFF while attributed is truncated does NOT mean causal attribution is complete
T1_1.why: a raw diff only shows the byte differed between arms; it passed no phase control, no alternative-mask comparison and no cross-start agreement

fields.rawDiffMembership: recorded separately and NEVER promoted to causal evidence
fields.reportTruncated: any reported list length equals the limit

T1_1.outcome: reportTruncated && !attributedMembership -> ADDRESS_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN, with rawDiffMembership stored as its own field and no effect on the status

T1_2.rule: absence of a final difference does not exclude an intermediate transition

outcomes.FINAL_STATE_UNCHANGED: endpoints matched and intermediate samples were not taken, or showed no change at the points checked
outcomes.NO_EVENT_IN_HORIZON: endpoints matched AND no intermediate sample across the whole horizon showed a change - assertable only with intermediate sampling throughout
outcomes.TRANSIENT_WITHIN_WINDOW: an intermediate sample showed a change absent at the end

T1_2.intermediateSampling: continuous-hold arms sample RAM every 12 frames of the horizon; like the S11C pre-snapshot this runs NO frames and does not alter the action structure

T2_adapterEquivalence.purpose: RECOVERED_BY_CADENCE compares a pulse train against a continuous control that, at 144/360/720, runs in the experimental adapter rather than the standard detector. If the adapter behaves differently the comparison would be between two instruments.
compared: phase tolerance and trajectory arm count
causal confirmation for the target address
onDivergence: keep BOTH results, adapter and standard
localise the cause before using RECOVERED_BY_CADENCE
until localised, mark the case ADAPTER_DIVERGENCE_UNRESOLVED and do not assign RECOVERED_BY_CADENCE
T2_adapterEquivalence.gate: equivalence is checked BEFORE the synthetic trials and is a precondition for starting them

instrumentRule: a limit of the observing instrument must never be presented as the absence of a game event
